SELECT s."Store_Name" AS store_name,
       COUNT(*) AS portable_scanner_count
FROM "store" s
JOIN "store_product" sp ON s."Store_ID" = sp."Store_ID"
JOIN "product" p ON sp."Product_ID" = p."product_id"
WHERE (json_extract('['||replace(p.dimensions,' x ',',')||']', '$[0]') *
       json_extract('['||replace(p.dimensions,' x ',',')||']', '$[1]') *

JOIN "product" p ON sp."Product_ID" = p."product_id"

WITH store_stats AS (
    SELECT s."Store_ID",
           s."Store_Name",
           SUM(CAST(substr(p.dimensions, 1, instr(p.dimensions, ' ') - 1) AS REAL) * 0.393701) AS total_length,
           AVG(p.dpi) AS average_dpi
    FROM "store" s
    JOIN "store_product" sp ON s."Store_ID" = sp."Store_ID"
    JOIN "product" p ON sp."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID"
    GROUP BY s."Store_ID", s."Store_Name"
)
SELECT "Store_Name", average_dpi
FROM store_stats
ORDER BY total_length DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    s.Store_Name,
    AVG(p.dpi) AS avg_dpi
FROM store s
JOIN store_product sp ON s.Store_ID = sp.Store_ID
JOIN product p ON sp.Product_ID = p.product_id
GROUP BY s.Store_ID
ORDER BY SUM(
    CAST(SUBSTR(p.dimensions, 1, INSTR(p.dimensions, ' ') - 1) AS REAL) / 2.54
) DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH store_lengths AS (
    SELECT sp."Store_ID",
           SUM(CAST(SUBSTR(p."dimensions", 1, INSTR(p."dimensions", ' ') - 1) AS REAL) / 2.54) AS total_length_in
    FROM "store_product" sp
    JOIN "product" p ON p."product_id" = sp."Product_ID"
    GROUP BY sp."Store_ID"
),
store_avg_dpi AS (
    SELECT sp."Store_ID",
           AVG(p."dpi") AS avg_dpi
    FROM "store_product" sp
    JOIN "product" p ON p."product_id" = sp."Product_ID"
    GROUP BY sp."Store_ID"
)
SELECT s."Store_Name",
       sad.avg_dpi
FROM store_lengths sl
JOIN store_avg_dpi sad ON sl."Store_ID" = sad."Store_ID"
JOIN "store" s ON s."Store_ID" = sl."Store_ID"
ORDER BY sl.total_length_in DESC

SELECT s."Store_ID" AS store_id,
       SUM(p."pages_per_minute_color") AS cumulative_color_ppm
FROM "store" s
JOIN "store_district" sd ON s."Store_ID" = sd."Store_ID"
JOIN "district" d ON sd."District_ID" = d."District_ID"
JOIN "store_product" sp ON s."Store_ID" = sp."Store_ID"
JOIN "product" p ON sp."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID"
GROUP BY s."Store_ID", d."District_ID"
ORDER BY d."District_ID", s."Store_ID";

WITH "eff" AS (
    SELECT
        "Store_Name",
        ("Number_of_product_category" / "Area_size") *
            (CASE WHEN "Type" = 'City Mall' THEN 1.2 ELSE 0.8 END) AS "efficiency",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ("Number_of_product_category" / "Area_size") *
            (CASE WHEN "Type" = 'City Mall' THEN 1.2 ELSE 0.8 END) DESC) AS "rn",
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS "total_cnt"
    FROM "store"
)
SELECT "Store_Name", "efficiency"
FROM "eff"
WHERE "rn" <= ("total_cnt" * 0.05)
ORDER BY "efficiency" DESC;

WITH store_efficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        Store_Name,
        CAST(Number_of_product_category AS REAL) / Area_size * 
        CASE 
            WHEN Type = 'City Mall' THEN 1.2
            WHEN Type = 'Village Store' THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0
        END AS efficiency_score
    FROM "store"
)
SELECT 
    Store_Name,
    efficiency_score
FROM store_efficiency
ORDER BY efficiency_score DESC
LIMIT (
    SELECT CAST(CEIL(COUNT(*) * 0.05) AS INTEGER) 
    FROM store_efficiency
)

WITH eff AS (
    SELECT "Store_Name",
           ("Number_of_product_category" / "Area_size") *
           CASE WHEN "Type" = 'City Mall' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.5 END AS efficiency
    FROM "store"
)
SELECT "Store_Name",
       efficiency
FROM (
    SELECT "Store_Name",
           efficiency,
           PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY efficiency) AS pr
    FROM eff
)
WHERE pr >= 0.95
ORDER BY efficiency DESC;

votes.sql:
WITH raw AS (
    SELECT
        "product".product,
        replace("product".dimensions, ' x ', '|') AS norm_dim
    FROM "product"
), split AS (
    SELECT
        product,
        CAST(trim(substr(norm_dim, 1, instr(norm_dim, '|') - 1)) AS REAL) AS d1,
        substr(norm_dim, instr(norm_dim, '|') + 1) AS rest_part
    FROM raw
), split2 AS (
    SELECT
        product,
        d1,
        CAST(trim(substr(rest_part, 1, instr(rest_part, '|') - 1)) AS REAL) AS d2,
        trim(substr(rest_part, instr(rest_part, '|') + 1)) AS d3_text
    FROM split
), final AS (
    SELECT
        product,
        d1,
        d2,
        CAST(d3_text AS REAL) AS d3
    FROM split2
)
SELECT
    product,
    (d1 * d2 * d3) * 0.001 AS volume_cm3
FROM final
ORDER BY volume_cm3 DESC;

WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        "product",
        CAST(substr("dimensions", 1, instr("dimensions", ' x ') - 1) AS REAL) AS l,
        CAST(substr(substr("dimensions", instr("dimensions", ' x ') + 3), 1, instr(substr("dimensions", instr("dimensions", ' x ') + 3), ' x ') - 1) AS REAL) AS w,
        CAST(substr(substr("dimensions", instr("dimensions", ' x ') + 3), instr(substr("dimensions", instr("dimensions", ' x ') + 3), ' x ') + 3) AS REAL) AS h
    FROM "product"
)
SELECT
    "product",
    (l * w * h) / 1000.0 AS volume_cm3
FROM parsed
ORDER BY volume_cm3 DESC;

WITH qualified_districts AS (
    SELECT d."District_ID"
    FROM "district" d
    WHERE (d."City_Population" / d."City_Area") > 1000
),
store_with_avg AS (
    SELECT s."Store_ID",
           s."Store_Name",
           s."Number_of_product_category",
           s."Ranking",
           sd."District_ID",
           AVG(s."Number_of_product_category") OVER (PARTITION BY sd."District_ID") AS avg_category
    FROM "store" s
    JOIN "store_district" sd ON s."Store_ID" = sd."Store_ID"
    WHERE sd."District_ID" IN (SELECT "District_ID" FROM qualified_districts)
)
SELECT "Store_Name"
FROM (
    SELECT "Store_Name",
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "Ranking" ASC) AS dr,
           MAX(DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "Ranking" ASC)) OVER () AS max_dr
    FROM store_with_avg
    WHERE "Number_of_product_category" > avg_category
) t
WHERE dr <= (max_dr * 0.1);

WITH district_population AS (
    SELECT 
        District_ID,
        CAST(City_Population AS REAL) / City_Area AS population_density
    FROM district
),
high_growth_districts AS (
    SELECT District_ID
    FROM district_population
    WHERE population_density > (SELECT AVG(population_density) FROM district_population)
),
district_avg_products AS (
    SELECT 
        sd.District_ID,
        AVG(s.Number_of_product_category) AS avg_products
    FROM store_district sd
    JOIN store s ON sd.Store_ID = s.Store_ID
    GROUP BY sd.District_ID
),
candidate_stores AS (
    SELECT 
        s.Store_ID,
        s.Store_Name,
        s.Ranking,
        s.Number_of_product_category,
        dap.avg_products,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.Ranking ASC) AS store_rank,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_candidates
    FROM store s
    JOIN store_district sd ON s.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
    JOIN high_growth_districts hgd ON sd.District_ID = hgd.District_ID
    JOIN district_avg_products dap ON sd.District_ID = dap.District_ID
    WHERE s.Number_of_product_category > dap.avg_products
)
SELECT Store_Name
FROM candidate_stores
WHERE store_rank <= CEIL(total_candidates * 0.1)

WITH sd AS (
    SELECT s.Store_ID,
           s.Store_Name,
           s.Number_of_product_category,
           s.Ranking,
           d.District_ID,
           (d.City_Population / d.City_Area) AS pop_density
    FROM store s
    JOIN store_district sdj ON s.Store_ID = sdj.Store_ID
    JOIN district d ON sdj.District_ID = d.District_ID
),
avg_pc AS (
    SELECT District_ID, AVG(Number_of_product_category) AS avg_pc
    FROM sd
    GROUP BY District_ID
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT sd.Store_ID,
           sd.Store_Name,
           sd.Number_of_product_category,
           sd.Ranking
    FROM sd
    JOIN avg_pc ap ON sd.District_ID = ap.District_ID
    WHERE sd.pop_density > 5000   -- Federal Population Density Threshold for 'High-Growth Zones'
      AND sd.Number_of_product_category > ap.avg_pc
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT Store_ID,
           Store_Name,
           Number_of_product_category,
           Ranking,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Ranking ASC) AS dr
    FROM filtered
),
total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM ranked
)
SELECT Store_Name
FROM ranked, total
WHERE dr <= CEIL(0.10 * total);

WITH dims AS (
    SELECT p."Product_ID",
           p."dpi",
           p."pages_per_minute_color",
           (
               CAST(substr(dim, 1, instr(dim, 'x') - 1) AS REAL) *
               CAST(substr(dim2, 1, instr(dim2, 'x') - 1) AS REAL) *
               CAST(substr(dim2, instr(dim2, 'x') + 1) AS REAL)
           ) / 1000.0 AS volume_cm3
    FROM "product" p
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT replace(p.dimensions, ' ', '') AS dim) d1
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT substr(dim, instr(dim, 'x') + 1) AS dim2) d2
)
SELECT s."Store_Name"
FROM "store" s
JOIN "store_product" sp ON s."Store_ID" = sp."Store_ID"
JOIN dims d ON sp."Product_ID" = d."Product_ID"
GROUP BY s."Store_ID"
HAVING SUM(d."pages_per_minute_color") >= 150
   AND MIN(d."dpi") >= 600
ORDER BY AVG(d.volume_cm3) DESC;

WITH product_vol AS (
    SELECT
        p."product_id",
        p."pages_per_minute_color",
        p."dpi",
        CAST(trim(substr(p."dimensions", 1, instr(p."dimensions", 'x')-1)) AS REAL) *
        CAST(trim(substr(substr(p."dimensions", instr(p."dimensions", 'x')+1), 1,
                         instr(substr(p."dimensions", instr(p."dimensions", 'x')+1), 'x')-1)) AS REAL) *
        CAST(trim(substr(substr(p."dimensions", instr(p."dimensions", 'x')+1),
                         instr(substr(p."dimensions", instr(p."dimensions", 'x')+1), 'x')+1)) AS REAL) AS volume
    FROM "product" p
),

        sp."Store_ID",

WITH gold_stores AS (
    SELECT s."Store_ID", sd."District_ID"
    FROM "store" s
    JOIN "store_district" sd ON s."Store_ID" = sd."Store_ID"
    WHERE s."Area_size" > (SELECT AVG("Area_size") FROM "store")
      AND s."Ranking" = 1
),

district_products AS (
    SELECT sd."District_ID",
           COUNT(DISTINCT sp."Product_ID") AS total_products
    FROM "store_district" sd
    JOIN "store_product" sp ON sd."Store_ID" = sp."Store_ID"
    GROUP BY sd."District_ID"
),

district_gold AS (
    SELECT gs."District_ID",
           COUNT(DISTINCT sp."Product_ID") AS gold_products
    FROM gold_stores gs
    JOIN "store_product" sp ON gs."Store_ID" = sp."Store_ID"
    GROUP BY gs."District_ID"
)
SELECT
    d."District_name",
    cum_gold * 1.0 / cum_total AS cumulative_proportion
FROM (
    SELECT d."District_ID",
           d."District_name",
           COALESCE(g.gold_products, 0) AS gold,
           dp.total_products,
           SUM(COALESCE(g.gold_products, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY d."District_ID" ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_gold,
           SUM(dp.total_products) OVER (ORDER BY d."District_ID" ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_total
    FROM "district" d
    JOIN district_products dp ON d."District_ID" = dp."District_ID"
    LEFT JOIN district_gold g ON d."District_ID" = g."District_ID"
) sub
ORDER BY cum_gold DESC;

    GROUP BY sd.District_ID

district_gs AS (

        COUNT(sp.Product_ID) AS gs_products
    FROM store_district sd

final_data AS (

        COALESCE(dg.gs_products, 0) AS gs_products,

)

FROM final_data
ORDER BY gs_products;

votes.sql:
WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product,
        replace(p.dimensions, ' x ', ',') AS dims
    FROM product p
), height_filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        product,
        CAST(
            substr(
                substr(dims, instr(dims, ',') + 1),
                instr(substr(dims, instr(dims, ',') + 1), ',') + 1
            ) AS REAL
        ) AS height_mm
    FROM parsed
)
SELECT DISTINCT hf.product, s."Store_Name"
FROM height_filtered hf
JOIN store_product sp ON sp.Product_ID = hf.product_id
JOIN "store" s ON s."Store_ID" = sp.Store_ID
WHERE hf.height_mm < 50.8;
